commercializationDefinition.goal: User visits, understands value, can try Free with low friction, naturally progresses to Paid, trusts the site enough to pay, can reuse/revisit, and feels comfortable sharing or recommending it.
qualitySignals: clear information architecture and conversion path
purposeful modern UI / animation rather than decorative complexity
low input burden with resume/prefill where appropriate
high-quality generated Japanese that does not look broken, generic, templated or cheap
public share output safe enough for affiliates and influencers to recommend to others
commercializationDefinition.humanRole: Human is the final brand/commercial judge, not the primary bug/typo finder. Deterministic checks plus independent semantic review must catch obvious content defects before Human review.
